description: A single ranked spend-by-category row in the Insights 'By Category' card: color dot, name, amount, percent, and a proportional progress bar.

amount.description: Total spent in this category for the month.

percent.description: Share of total spending, 0-100. Drives progress bar width.

color.description: API-supplied category color. When absent, fall back to the palette-derived list by rank index.

rankIndex.description: 0-based rank; used to index the fallback palette when color is absent.

isOverflowRow.description: True for the trailing '+N more' aggregate row (summed amount/percent of the remaining categories).

onPress.description: Only set on the overflow row to expand the full list (progressive disclosure).

accessibility.label: {name}, {amount}, {percent} percent of spending
accessibility.minTouchTarget: 44pt tall only when onPress is set (overflow row)
accessibility.note: identity is the labeled name+amount; the dot is decorative reinforcement only
